summary.description: The question or summary sentence, shown first (plain text, newlines kept). http(s) addresses in the text become links.

actor.description: Who acts next. bot (default): Approve / Reject, and Request changes when allow_changes is set; results approve, reject, request_changes. user: the person does it (Done / Skip; results done / skipped). none: info only (Got it / Request changes; results acknowledged / request_changes). The bot never acts on user or none.

action.description: Optional verb for the bot's approve label. post becomes Approve & post, send becomes Approve & send, any other verb (including deploy) becomes Approve & continue. Ignored unless actor is bot.

approve_label.description: Optional override of the primary button once Approve is picked, e.g. "Approve deploy". Wins over action. Default is Approve, or the action phrase when action is set.

allow_changes.description: Offer "Request changes" (comment required) as a third choice.

facts.description: Key facts as label/value pairs under the summary (amount, requester, version, period).

mono.description: Show the value in the monospace font (versions, ids, amounts).

copy.description: Values the person would otherwise retype; each is shown in full next to its button.

text.description: Exact string that lands on the clipboard.

points_title.description: Heading of the points list; default "Details".

points.description: Short bullet points (what changes, why it is needed).

checks.description: Checks with a status dot (tests, policies, prior approvals).

reference.description: A longer value behind a closed disclosure (rollback command, full terms), with a copy button.

text.description: Exact string that lands on the clipboard.

mono.description: Show the text in the monospace font (commands, paths).
